title: QiT: Quantum-Inspired Transformer for Visual Recognition Task
abstract: arXiv:2609.17789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum machine learning offers a compelling representational perspective: angle-encoded states inhabit Hilbert spaces in which periodic similarities and interactions can be expressed naturally. Realizing this perspective for visual recognition remains difficult, however, because present quantum neural networks are constrained by limited qubit counts, costly circuit simulation and measurement, noise, and unstable optimization on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. We investigate whether useful structural ideas from quantum models can instead be realized as scalable classical Transformer operations. We introduce QiT, a Quantum-inspired Transformer for vision tasks with three components: (i) angle-inspired encoding that maps image tokens to learned trigonometric Hilbert-space features analogous to quantum rotation-based state encoding; (ii) self-attention over these periodic features, inducing a classical cosine kernel approximated

translated_title: QiT：面向视觉识别任务的量子启发Transformer
translated_abstract: 量子机器学习提供了一种引人注目的表示视角：角度编码的量子态存在于希尔伯特空间中，其中周期性的相似性和相互作用可以被自然地表达。然而，将这一视角应用于视觉识别仍然很困难，因为当前的量子神经网络受到量子比特数量有限、电路模拟与测量成本高昂、噪声干扰以及在含噪中等规模量子设备上优化不稳定的限制。我们研究了量子模型中有用的结构思想是否可以转而实现为可扩展的经典Transformer操作。我们提出了QiT，一种面向视觉任务的量子启发Transformer，它包含三个组件：（i）角度启发编码，将图像token映射为学习到的三角函数希尔伯特空间特征，类似于基于量子旋转的态编码；（ii）对这些周期性特征的自注意力，诱导出一种近似的经典余弦核
tldr: 提出量子启发Transformer（QiT），通过角度启发编码和周期性特征上的自注意力机制，将量子机器学习的结构性思想转化为可扩展的经典Transformer操作，用于视觉识别任务。
en_tdlr: QiT is a Quantum-inspired Transformer that converts key structural ideas from quantum machine learning—angle-inspired trigonometric encoding and self-attention over periodic features inducing a classical cosine kernel—into scalable classical Transformer operations for visual recognition.
